name: Himukai Akira
source: The protagonist's girlfriend. A university student. They've been in a half-hearted relationship for a while now. She has a quiet and reserved personality, and often doesn't say what she wants to say. She gets accepted into a top university far away, which she didn't think she'd get into, and in front of her overjoyed parents, she can't bring herself to tell them that she's going to a low-level local university because she has a crush on someone else, so she moves away to attend the new university.
